/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md
jq -r '.stack_frames[]' samples.jsonl | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -80
jq -r '[.value,.labels.comparison_side[0],.stack_frames[0],.stack_frames[2],.stack_frames[3]]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$3 FS $4 FS $5; s[k]+=$1; n[k]++} END {for(k in s) print s[k],n[k],k}'"' | sort -nr | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value,.stack_frames[0],.stack_frames[2],.stack_frames[3]]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '
{v="'$1; total[v>0?"bad":"good"]+= (v>0?v:-v); if($2=="result:repeated"){rep[v>0?"bad":"good"]+=(v>0?v:-v)}; if($3=="action:noop"&&$4=="strategy:wait"){nw[v>0?"bad":"good"]+=(v>0?v:-v)}; if($2=="result:repeated"&&$3=="action:noop"&&$4=="strategy:wait"){rnw[v>0?"bad":"good"]+=(v>0?v:-v)}} END {for(s in total) printf "%s total=%d repeated=%d repeated_rate=%.4f noop_wait=%d noop_wait_rate=%.4f repeated_noop_wait=%d'"\\n\",s,total[s],rep[s],rep[s]/total[s],nw[s],nw[s]/total[s],rnw[s]}'
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.value,.stack_frames[2],.stack_frames[3]]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$2" + "$3; if($1>0)p[k]+=$1;else n[k]+=-$1} END{for(k in p) printf "%d'"\\t%d\\t%+d\\t%s\\n\",p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k],k}' | sort -nr | head -20
wc -l samples.jsonl"
